desc: The longship was similar to the drakkar but much smaller—typically 70​ to ​80 feet (21​ to ​24 meters) along the keel and 15​ to ​20 feet (4.6​ to ​6.1 meters) across the beam. With 20 oars on each side, the minimum crew size was 40 plus three watchmen and could carry a maximum crew of between 60 and 200 including rowers. Longships could sail, assuming moderate, favorable winds and calm seas, at a maximum speed of 16 nautical miles per hour with sail and between two and ten while propelled by oars.
name: longship
